title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and sustains in a population under social influence, policies, supply constraints, and information campaigns.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask-wearing among their social neighbors and update their propensity to adopt accordingly.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities and locations enforce mask requirements; non-compliant persons may be denied entry or fined.

interactions.name: purchase_and_supply
interactions.description: Persons attempt to purchase masks from retailers, constrained by stock, price, and rationing policies.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Authorities and information channels broadcast messages that affect risk perception, trust, and adoption.

interactions.name: movement_and_contacts
interactions.description: Persons move among locations (home, work/school, public spaces) and experience social exposure that can influence adoption decisions.

interactions.name: free_mask_distribution
interactions.description: Authorities distribute masks (e.g., at locations or via community programs), affecting access and adoption.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily fraction of the population wearing masks.

metrics.name: average_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mean adoption rate over the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until at least 50% of the population adopts masking.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_last_14_days
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final 14 days.

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Observed fraction wearing masks while present in locations with mandates.

metrics.name: subgroup_adoption_gap_income
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between top and bottom income quintiles.

metrics.name: stockout_days
metrics.description: Total number of retailer-days with zero mask stock.

metrics.name: masks_purchased_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of masks purchased per person.

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Total cost of enforcement and campaigns minus fines collected.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of compliance checks resulting in fines or denial of entry.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: For all days, adoption_rate_over_time is between 0 and 1.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_last_14_days
validation_criteria.description: Absolute day-to-day change in adoption rate < 0.005 for at least 10 of the final 14 days.

validation_criteria.name: mandate_effect_sanity_check
validation_criteria.description: With mandates enabled and enforcement_probability > 0, adoption increases by at least 5 percentage points within 14 days after mandate_start_day (in typical parameter settings).

validation_criteria.name: nonnegative_inventory
validation_criteria.description: Retailer stock never falls below 0 at any timestep.

validation_criteria.name: reproducibility_fixed_seed
validation_criteria.description: With the same random_seed, two runs produce identical metric time series.
